settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure NS8 Active Directory / OpenLDAP group coupling, public endpoint, Split-Tunnel routing, Self-Service Portal, and OpenVPN fallback.
settings.saved_description: WireGuard, OpenVPN, Traefik portal route, firewall rules, and AD/LDAP sync settings have been applied.
settings.section_ldap_description: Bind this VPN instance to an internal or external NethServer 8 user domain. Users disabled in AD/LDAP or removed from the VPN group lose tunnel access automatically.
settings.user_domain_helper: Active Directory (Samba) and OpenLDAP (RFC2307) domains registered in NethServer 8.
settings.no_user_domains_warning: No user domains were found on this NethServer 8 cluster. Install Samba AD or OpenLDAP in Software Center first.
settings.vpn_group_placeholder: Select group or enter group name (e.g. vpn-users)...
settings.vpn_group_helper: Only members of this group (including nested Active Directory groups) are authorized. Leave empty to allow all active users of the selected domain.
settings.sync_interval_helper: Periodic background verification interval between 1 and 60 minutes (default: 5).
settings.max_devices_helper: Maximum number of simultaneous VPN profiles per user between 1 and 20 (default: 3).
settings.section_endpoint_description: Clients connect to this external hostname, DDNS address, or static public IP.
settings.endpoint_host_helper: Must be reachable from the internet (no http:// or port suffix).
settings.wg_port_helper: Default is 51820/udp. Opened automatically in the NS8 node firewall (firewalld public zone).
settings.wg_port_cluster_warning: Port 55820/udp is reserved by NethServer 8 for internal cluster WireGuard (wg0) and cannot be used!
settings.router_box_description: Forward external port UDP {port} on your internet router (e.g. FritzBox -> Internet -> Permit Access -> Port Sharing) to NS8 host LAN IP {lanIp}, destination port {port}/udp.
settings.router_box_description_no_ip: Forward external port UDP {port} on your internet router (e.g. FritzBox) to this NethServer 8 host on destination port {port}/udp.
settings.section_network_description: Control which networks roadwarrior clients can reach and how internal company hostnames are resolved.
settings.tunnel_mode_split: Split-Tunnel — route only internal company networks through VPN (recommended)
settings.tunnel_mode_full: Full-Tunnel — route all internet and internal traffic through VPN (0.0.0.0/0)
settings.tunnel_mode_split_helper: Server-side nftables rules strictly enforce allowed destination networks even if a client modifies its local VPN configuration.
settings.tunnel_mode_full_helper: All client traffic traverses this VPN server; NS8 cluster network (wg0) remains strictly isolated.
settings.allowed_cidrs_helper: Enter one IPv4 CIDR subnet per line (or comma-separated) that roadwarrior clients may access.
settings.dns_servers_helper: Optional IPv4 addresses (comma- or newline-separated), e.g. your NS8 Samba AD Domain Controller IP for internal name resolution.
settings.dns_search_domain_helper: Allows clients to resolve short internal hostnames (auto-suggested when selecting a user domain).
settings.section_portal_description: Publish an HTTPS web portal via ns8-traefik where authorized employees sign in with their AD/LDAP credentials to enroll 2FA and manage their own VPN devices.
settings.portal_domain_helper: Must point to this NS8 node (ports 80/443 via Traefik).
settings.portal_totp_required: Mandatory (2FA enrollment enforced before downloading VPN profiles)
settings.section_ovpn_title: OpenVPN Server (TCP / Hotel Fallback & Live Password Auth)
settings.section_ovpn_description: Optional OpenVPN server alongside WireGuard for restrictive hotel, guest Wi-Fi, or corporate firewalls blocking UDP, with live AD/LDAP password verification on every connection.
settings.ovpn_proto_tcp: TCP — recommended to traverse restrictive hotel & guest network firewalls
settings.ovpn_proto_udp: UDP — lower latency when UDP is permitted
settings.ovpn_port: Local listen port on NS8 node
settings.ovpn_port_helper: Default: 1194 (opened automatically in firewalld on this NS8 node).
settings.ovpn_port_traefik_warning: TCP port 443 on the NS8 node is usually bound by ns8-traefik! Keep local port 1194 and forward external TCP 443 -> 1194 on your router if Traefik is not exposed on WAN.
settings.ovpn_public_port: External router / WAN port in .ovpn profile
settings.ovpn_public_port_helper: Written into client .ovpn files (e.g. 443 if your router forwards WAN TCP 443 -> NS8 1194, otherwise 1194).
settings.ovpn_router_box_description: Forward external {proto} port {publicPort} on your router (e.g. FritzBox) to internal NS8 IP {lanIp}, destination port {localPort}/{proto}.
settings.ovpn_router_box_description_no_ip: Forward external {proto} port {publicPort} on your router to this NS8 node, destination port {localPort}/{proto}.
settings.ovpn_network_helper: Dedicated IPv4 pool for OpenVPN clients (default: 10.199.1.0/24). Must not overlap WireGuard or LAN subnets.
settings.ovpn_totp_required: Require 6-digit TOTP code in addition to AD/LDAP password on connect
settings.ovpn_totp_required_helper: When enabled, OpenVPN clients authenticate by entering <AD-Password><6-digit-TOTP-code>.
settings.wg_network_helper: Dedicated tunnel address pool (default: 10.199.0.0/24). Must not overlap your LAN or NS8 cluster VPN (10.5.4.0/24).
settings.nat_enabled: Enable NAT / Masquerading toward internal LAN
settings.nat_enabled_off: Disabled (requires static return route on LAN gateway)
settings.nat_enabled_helper: Translates VPN client traffic to the NS8 node's LAN IP so internal servers behind a FritzBox or Speedport respond immediately without configuring static routes.
settings.wg_mtu_helper: 1280–1420 bytes (default: 1380 — optimal for PPPoE / DSL / FritzBox connections and mobile networks).
settings.persistent_keepalive_helper: Keeps NAT mappings open for roadwarriors behind Carrier-Grade NAT or hotel firewalls (default: 25, 0 to disable).
settings.validation_endpoint_required: Please enter the public hostname, DDNS name, or public IP address.
settings.validation_endpoint_invalid: Please enter a valid hostname or IPv4 address without protocol or port.
settings.validation_port_range: UDP port must be an integer between 1024 and 65535.
settings.validation_port_cluster: Port 55820/udp is reserved for the NS8 cluster VPN (wg0). Please choose another port (e.g. 51820).
settings.validation_cidrs_required: At least one internal network CIDR is required in Split-Tunnel mode.
settings.validation_wg_network_invalid: Please enter a valid IPv4 subnet CIDR (e.g. 10.199.0.0/24).
settings.validation_wg_network_cluster: 10.5.4.0/24 is reserved for the NS8 internal cluster network (wg0).
settings.validation_wg_network_overlap: Transfer subnet must not overlap with allowed internal networks.
settings.validation_ovpn_wg_overlap: OpenVPN subnet must not overlap with the WireGuard transfer subnet.
settings.validation_ovpn_port_wg_conflict: OpenVPN UDP port must not be identical to the WireGuard UDP port.
settings.validation_portal_domain_invalid: Please enter a valid FQDN (e.g. vpn-portal.company.de) without protocol or path.
settings.validation_sync_range: Sync interval must be between 1 and 60 minutes.
settings.validation_max_devices_range: Maximum devices per user must be between 1 and 20.
settings.validation_keepalive_range: Persistent keepalive must be 0 or between 10 and 300 seconds.

about.title: About
about.description_fallback: Business Roadwarrior & Site-to-Site VPN (WireGuard & OpenVPN) integrated with NethServer 8 Active Directory and OpenLDAP user lifecycle management.
about.highlight_wireguard: Dedicated kernel WireGuard (wg-<instance>) & OpenVPN (tun-<instance>) interfaces strictly isolated from NS8 cluster wg0.
about.highlight_ldap: Automatic Active Directory & OpenLDAP group synchronization with instant WireGuard & OpenVPN session termination on account disable.
about.highlight_firewall: End-User HTTPS Self-Service Portal with TOTP 2FA, Site-to-Site FritzBox/branch coupling, and server-side nftables Split-Tunnel enforcement.
about.highlight_audit: Tamper-evident compliance Audit Log with RFC-4180 CSV export, optional static client VPN IPs, and IPv4/IPv6 Dual-Stack OpenVPN (DS-Lite ready).
about.highlight_backup: Full Restic cluster backup & restore support preserving encrypted WireGuard keys, OpenVPN PKI, and 2FA secrets across migrations.
